maria_marketing: Quick request for launch assets: need validated benchmark numbers + reproducible artifacts for three headline claims (gen p95, embed p95, cost/1k tokens). Prefer smoke today and full sweep next week. Can runtime take this?

sam_runtime: Yes. Clarify models, payload pack, sample sizes, and whether cold-starts required. Also where to drop embargoed artifacts?

maria_marketing: Models: redwood-alpha-7b:fp16 (2026-03-01) and redwood-alpha-7b:quant8 (2026-03-05). Payload: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/payloads/launch-pack-v6.json. Smoke: 30 samples each. Full: gen 8k, long-complete 1k, embeds 5k. Include stratified slices (web/mobile/api). Cold-start = first after 5m idle. Drop artifacts to s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-1933333333/ with embargo ACL. Tolerances: suggest p95 +/-10% and cost delta <=15%.

alan_ops: I'll create the S3 folder and set embargo to 2026-04-08; add watchers: marketing and platform-metrics.

sam_runtime: We'll run smoke with seed=20260330 for determinism. Per-request CSV fields: request_id, model, seq_in, seq_out, tokens, latency_ms, gpu_util_pct, mem_mb, trace_url. Smoke ETA ~1h.

perf-bot: queued bench-1933333333-smoke (est 1h).

perf-bot: bench-1933333333-smoke finished  summary uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-1933333333/smoke/summary.csv. Raw traces at s3://.../traces/. Preliminary numbers: fp16 gen p95 = 178ms, quant8 gen p95 = 196ms (+10%), embeddings (batch8) p95 = 29ms, estimated cost delta quant8 ~11% lower.

maria_marketing: Great. Draft one-liners and an embargoed blurb for the press kit? Legal will review.

sam_runtime: Draft one-liners (prelim):
- redwood-alpha-7b:fp16  p95 gen 178ms (steady-state).
- redwood-alpha-7b:quant8  p95 gen 196ms (+10%), cost ~11% lower on this workload.
- Embeddings (batch8): p95 29ms.
Embargoed blurb (internal): "Internal benchmark on a representative launch payload shows quantized variant reduces per-token compute cost with measured tail latency tradeoffs; see appendix for methodology and raw traces."

anya_legal: Change "measured" to "measured" (typo check) and add methodology link: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-1933333333/methodology.txt. Also recommend wording tolerances in the press note.

sam_runtime: Will add methodology link and include recommended tolerances for PR (p95 <= headline +10%, cost variance <=15%). We'll schedule full sweep Tue 02:00-06:00 in low-traffic window; burst nodes optional.

maria_marketing: Proceed with full sweep if smoke within tolerances. Ping #marketing when queued and again when artifacts live.
